name: __start
evidence: PS-X EXE entry (pc0); clears BSS 0x8009B9A8..0x800B0548, sets gp 0x8009B9A8 and sp, InitHeap, calls main

name: main
evidence: The game's main loop: one-time init (game_init), then forever: wait for the frame, swap buffers, run the handler of g_game_state (switch over the 20 game states), then two calls to 0x8007BAB0 on the frame's work buffers.
summary: The game's main loop: one-time init (game_init), then forever: wait for the frame, swap buffers, run the handler of g_game_state (switch over the 20 game states), then two calls to 0x8007BAB0 on the frame's work buffers.

name: v_wait
evidence: libetc static: spins until Vcount (0x8009AC68) >= a0, timeout a1<<15 iterations then puts "VSync: timeout"

name: VSync
evidence: libetc: the only caller of v_wait

name: cd_init
evidence: CdSearchFile for \TEKKEN3\TEKKEN3.BNS;1 (-> 0x800A05E0) and \TEKKEN3\TEKKEN3.XAS;1 (-> 0x800A0670)

name: bns_read
evidence: queues a read of TEKKEN3.BNS file (index via 0x80098574) to a destination: table of contents at 0x80024400 (sector offset, size), LBA = CdPosToInt(BNS) + offset

name: heap_layout
evidence: lays out the heap from 0x800B8D58 (mode package load address) by game mode

name: game_init
evidence: One-time initialisation run by main before the loop (heap_layout, the CD file lookup cd_init and further set-up calls); this code lives in the overlay area and is overwritten by the overlays later.
summary: One-time initialisation run by main before the loop (heap_layout, the CD file lookup cd_init and further set-up calls); this code lives in the overlay area and is overwritten by the overlays later.

name: setjmp
evidence: libapi: stores ra, sp, fp, s0..s7 and gp into the buffer and returns 0 (the BIOS-free setjmp libetc uses); its callers' return addresses are where the interrupt exit hook resumes

name: ResetCallback
evidence: libetc: clears I_MASK/I_STAT, setjmp(&intr_jmpbuf 0x80099BD8) then HookEntryInt, _96_remove; the setjmp return path calls trapIntr

name: trapIntr
evidence: libetc static: interrupt dispatcher (I_STAT & I_MASK -> callback table 0x80099BA4), prints "unexpected interrupt(%04x)" before ResetCallback, ends with ReturnFromException

name: set_display_frozen
evidence: frozen = 1 stops the per-frame screen output (g_display_active = 0), e.g. while a load runs; 0 resumes it.
summary: frozen = 1 stops the per-frame screen output (g_display_active = 0), e.g. while a load runs; 0 resumes it.

name: is_display_frozen
evidence: True while the screen output is frozen (see set_display_frozen).
summary: True while the screen output is frozen (see set_display_frozen).

name: frame_wait_vsync
evidence: Start of each frame: flushes the previous frame's drawing if the display is active, then waits for the vertical blank counter (g_vsync_count, raised by the VSync callback) while doing background work and stepping the random number seed.
summary: Start of each frame: flushes the previous frame's drawing if the display is active, then waits for the vertical blank counter (g_vsync_count, raised by the VSync callback) while doing background work and stepping the random number seed.

name: get_draw_buffer
evidence: Index (0 / 1) of the display buffer that is drawn this frame.
summary: Index (0 / 1) of the display buffer that is drawn this frame.

name: load_queue_add
evidence: Append a load request (destination address, BNS file index, argument) to the load queue (at most 8); false if the queue is full. The queue is worked through by game state 1.
summary: Append a load request (destination address, BNS file index, argument) to the load queue (at most 8); false if the queue is full. The queue is worked through by game state 1.

name: load_queue_overlay
evidence: Queue loading BNS file `bns_file` (an overlay, files 5..8) to the overlay address 0x800B0548.
summary: Queue loading BNS file `bns_file` (an overlay, files 5..8) to the overlay address 0x800B0548.

name: load_queue_package
evidence: Queue loading BNS file `bns_file` (a mode package or data) to the package / heap area 0x800B8D58.
summary: Queue loading BNS file `bns_file` (a mode package or data) to the package / heap area 0x800B8D58.

name: goto_state
evidence: Switch to game state `state` / sub-state `substate`. If loads are queued, freeze the display, start the first load and go through state 1 (the loader), which switches to the requested state when everything is loaded.
summary: Switch to game state `state` / sub-state `substate`. If loads are queued, freeze the display, start the first load and go through state 1 (the loader), which switches to the requested state when everything is loaded.

name: load_start
evidence: Start reading BNS file `bns_file` to `dest`. Files below 10 are code (overlays / packages): remember to flush the instruction cache when the read is done.
summary: Start reading BNS file `bns_file` to `dest`. Files below 10 are code (overlays / packages): remember to flush the instruction cache when the read is done.

name: load_busy
evidence: 1 while the current BNS read is still running; when it has finished, flushes the instruction cache if code was loaded and returns 0.
summary: 1 while the current BNS read is still running; when it has finished, flushes the instruction cache if code was loaded and returns 0.

name: load_prepare_next
evidence: If the CD is idle, prepare the next BNS file of the queue (calls the CD layer at 0x8006C250 with its index).
summary: If the CD is idle, prepare the next BNS file of the queue (calls the CD layer at 0x8006C250 with its index).

name: state01_loader
evidence: Game state 1: loads every queued BNS file one after the other, then switches to the state goto_state() was asked for.

Every frame it also draws the screen.
